description: This file defines the AppState class, a ChangeNotifier in Flutter that manages the application's state related to expenses, months, categories, budgets, and transactions. It interacts with an ExpenseRepository to load and modify data, providing reactive updates to the UI.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class for managing the app's expense-related state, including months, budgets, categories, and transactions, with methods to initialize, change month, load data, and update budgets.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the repository, loads available months, sets the current or default month, and loads associated data.

methods.name: changeMonth
methods.description: Changes the selected month and reloads data for that month.

methods.name: _loadMonthData
methods.description: Loads total expenses, category breakdown, transactions, and budgets for the selected month.

methods.name: setBudget
methods.description: Sets or updates a budget for a category in the current month and refreshes the budgets list.

methods.name: ensureCategoriesLoaded
methods.description: Loads all categories once for use in budget editing; caches the categories.
